Cleanest of the six variants (typed, sorted methods, preserves the HEAD exclusion), self-contained, and low risk.

rationale: Same count-to-limit change in passkey service, auth service, and CLI as PR 994. No behavioral difference from the canonical variant.

rationale: Sanitizes the stored original filename (basename after separator normalization, with a fallback) before it reaches the Content-Disposition header and caps stored filename length at upload. title: 🎨 Palette: Add accessible required indicators to form fields
rationale: Most complete variant of the required-field indicator PRs: adds aria-hidden asterisks in Input/PasswordField, applies the required attribute on Login and Register forms, and updates label-based tests to regex queries. Small but real template UX improvement at proportionate cost.

better_alternative: Keep the curated grouped route sections and add the generated table (or keep the original presence-only check) instead of replacing the prose
rationale: Generated OpenAPI table does end route drift, but at the cost of deleting curated README content: the grouped endpoint sections, the passkey flow narrative, and the password-route bullets are replaced by a flat alphabetical table. rationale: Replaces a bootstrap-admin COUNT(*) with a limit(1) existence check; correct and harmless, but the count runs only on registration when first_user_is_admin is set, so the claimed O(N) bottleneck is mostly theoretical.

title: 🎨 Palette: Improve AI Chat interaction UX
rationale: Competing variant of 269's chat improvement using Ctrl+Enter instead of Enter and the Button isLoading state; the plain-Enter behavior in 269 is the more standard chat convention.

rationale: Fixes a real tooling bug: FastAPI 0.115+ hides included-router endpoints from app.routes, so the doc-drift script silently under-reported routes; switching to app.openapi() paths is the correct enumeration.

title: ∴ Vector: Centralize base32 ID validation logic
rationale: Collapses three copy-pasted base32 ID validators into one _is_valid_id helper and switches the allowed-char set to frozenset; small, correct, drift-proof.
